en: Built to last 2 years, this space telescope lasted 22.
Launched in Nov. 2004, it caught 2,000+ gamma-ray bursts, the universe's most powerful blasts.
Its data led to about 7,000 scientific papers.
But as solar activity rose, its orbit kept dropping,
and this summer, a rescue mission to raise its orbit failed.
On October 20, it made its final observation.
It's expected to reenter the atmosphere and break apart within weeks.
Ten times its design life. Well done, Swift.
